input.request: Looking for a stainless steel water bottle, at least 32 oz, that fits a standard car cup holder. Must be dishwasher safe. A straw lid would be nice but is not required.
input.listing: Summit 40 oz Insulated Bottle. 18/8 stainless steel, double-wall vacuum insulation. Tapered base fits most car cup holders. Dishwasher safe (top rack). Includes screw-top lid; straw lid sold separately.
